source.note: Firm's own United Kingdom graduates-and-interns page, which sets out programme dates, application dates and an eligibility line per programme.

apply.note: Firm's own UK graduates-and-interns page; it states the application window for each programme.

class_year.quote: To be eligible for our Summer Internship Programme, you must be in your penultimate year of study of an undergraduate or master’s degree at the time of application, or a final year undergraduate and planning to undertake a Masters; and graduating in 2027.

cooling_off.notes: The page carries no sentence addressing reapplication, waiting periods, or a cap on applications. Searched the fetched markup for 'reappl', 're-appl', 'apply again' and 'waiting period': no match.

unfiled_quotes.quote: To be eligible for our Graduate Programme, you must be in your final year of study of an undergraduate degree or a master's degree and completing your studies in 2026.
Off-cycle internship opportunities suit a motivated student in their final or gap year, or a recent graduate.

provenance.note: opens and closes are transcribed from the firm's stated application window for this programme (Opens: 1 September 2026, Closes: 30 October 2026) and converted to ISO dates; the programme itself is stated to run 14 June - 13 August 2027. Note an inconsistency on the firm's own page, left as found: the Graduate Programme is dated 26 July 2027 while its eligibility line says 'completing your studies in 2026'.
